chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 589: Ji Ning's Karmic Merit Secret & the Daomerge Gambit
chapter_meta_description: The dust settles on Evergreen's fall. Ji Ning uncovers the secret of his karmic merit, while the Lord of All Demons risks all in a Daomerge. The Realm War looms.
og_title: Ji Ning Kills a True Immortal – The Secret Behind His Power Revealed!
og_description: The Three Realms tremble as the Sword Immortal of All Things reflects on the strength that has guided him since his past life. The Seamless Gate prepares a desperate gambit.
twitter_title: The Legend of Ji Ning Explodes Across the Three Realms!
twitter_description: Ji Ning learns the true power of his karmic merit! A Daofather-level threat emerges from the Seamless Gate as the Realm War draws closer.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning suddenly become so powerful?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter reveals that the massive karmic merit from his past life on Earth has been a silent, foundational boost to his cultivation, and he was finally able to consciously tap into the Pangu power it granted.
It's the final, life-or-death step for a Samsara Daolord to become a Daofather. Success grants control over the heavens; failure means absolute annihilation of body and soul.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of this 'breather' chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It serves as a psychological reset after the intense battle, allowing Ji Ning and the readers to process the power scaling and emotional fallout before the plot escalates towards the Realm War.
